profile.headline: Software Developer at Medical Mutual
profile.summary: I am passionate about security and programming. I absolutely love to create applications or maintain them while trying to figure out problems. I am dedicated and always willing to learn. I am friendly, understanding, and I am a team player. I am also a humble person and I also like to contribute my time and ideas to a good cause.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Developer IV / Senior Developer / Technical Lead

- Promoted through 4 internal levels based on performance, ownership, and leadership
- Led architecture and development for internal/public applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC, SQL, Sitecore
- Directed digitization of enrollment workflows; replaced paper-based processes with scalable vendor-integrated systems
- Built platforms from the ground up for acquired companies; empowered non-technical teams to self-manage content
- Introduced Docker-based dev automation and onboarding standards adopted team-wide
- Mentored developers and led multi-team collaboration, improving delivery velocity and cross-team synergy
- Supported modernization with Kubernetes and OpenShift; helped guide other teams through infrastructure upgrades

positions.title: Systems Developer II
positions.description: Develop and maintain software used frequently by employees, using the languages SQL, Java, and C#. Ability to work on large-scale projects with a team. Having a decent knowledge of Windows and Unix operating systems and collaboration software. Troubleshoot and resolve software issues. Experience working in an Agile environment.

positions.title: Helpdesk
positions.description: Troubleshooting software and hardware for student machines and faculty machines. Installing networking hardware such as network cameras. Assisting faculty and staff by instructing them how to use specific equipment. Doing program upgrades, reimaging faculty and lab machines, submissions for warranty, and proper disposal of unused hardware.

positions.title: PCHO Sales Associate
positions.description: Assisting all customers, making sure no customer goes unassisted. Inform the customers about computers and what the differences are, and help them choose one that will fit their lifestyle and budget. Work as a team and ensure that each day is a successful day budget-wise and moral-wise. Promote the store deals and provide world class service to each and every customer.

positions.title: Karate Instructor
positions.description:
Instructing children how to defend themselves from strangers, bullies, and teaching new content such as techniques, katas, and weapon training. Talking about morals and teaching things that will help enhance their personality such as integrity, honesty, and being humble and kind. 

Assisting those under my current rank on the techniques and katas that they must learn in order to advance their belt rank. Emphasize proper stances, forms, and train with them allowing them to get as much practice as possible to ensure success and achieve a higher understand of the techniques and katas.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Martin Luther King Day - Raider Programming Board
volunteerExperiences.description: Was amazing to be able to help out those in need while supporting equality on Martin Luther King Day. We ended up making a large amount of food to give to those that are less fortunate. We unloaded the trucks of ingredients and immediately got to work, while another group was working on sending letters of support to those less fortunate.

company.name: Martin Luther King Day - Raider Programming Board

organizations.name: Alpha Phi Omega Service Fraternity
organizations.description: Alpha Phi Omega is a service fraternity in which members dedicate their time in helping those in need and making a difference in the community and the world.
